description: This is a Perl script designed for flashing firmware onto a D-Link DSL-502T router. It handles identifying the device, verifying firmware compatibility, configuring memory technology device (MTD) parameters, and performing the firmware update process including erasing and writing the new firmware, followed by rebooting the device.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP customized for interacting with the ADAM2 bootloader on the router, implementing methods for environment variable retrieval and reboot command.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server, ensuring uppercase command format.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable value from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get a specific environment variable.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends the reboot command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via FTP.
